## Coming soon

Activity 3 will walk through planning your own simulation study using the ADEMP framework introduced in [Designing a Simulation Study](overview.qmd) — starting from a research question of your choosing, through specifying a data-generating mechanism, an estimand, candidate methods, and performance measures.

Check back closer to the workshop date, or watch the [workshop repository](https://github.com/ktwiener/ispe-simulation-workshop) for updates.
